content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

By using Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can create a payment and delivery pipeline that is not tied to any single platform or country. This means that you can receive payments in any cryptocurrency, without worrying about platform restrictions or delays. With NOWPayments, you can process transactions in seconds, and send products to customers instantly, without relying on a centralized payment gateway.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you'll need to set up a Cloudflare account, create a Supabase instance, and sign up for a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency to use for payments, and set up a payment method for your NOWPayments account. Finally, you'll need to create a Cloudflare Workers script to handle incoming payments and send products to customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a NOWPayments webhook and connect it to your Cloudflare Workers script. You'll also need to set up a payment method for your NOWPayments account, and configure your Cloudflare Pages instance to display your products. Finally, you'll need to test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly.
This infrastructure is designed to be fast, scalable, and secure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. To do this, you'll need to update your Cloudflare Pages instance to point to your NOWPayments webhook, and configure your Cloudflare Workers script to send products to customers. When a customer makes a payment, your Cloudflare Workers script will receive the payment notification and send the product to the customer instantly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can start scaling your business by adding more products, increasing your payment volume, and configuring your Cloudflare Workers script to handle multiple payment notifications at once. To do this, you'll need to upgrade your NOWPayments account to a higher plan, and configure your Cloudflare Pages instance to handle increased traffic. Finally, you'll need to test your infrastructure to ensure that it can handle the increased load.

With NOWPayments, you can process transactions in seconds, and send products to customers instantly, without relying on a centralized payment gateway. This means that you can focus on creating and selling digital products, without worrying about payment delays or platform restrictions.

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare account and set up a Supabase instance; Sign up for a NOWPayments account and choose a cryptocurrency for payments; Create a Cloudflare Workers script to handle incoming payments and send products to customers; Set up a payment method for your NOWPayments account and configure your Cloudflare Pages instance to display your products; Test your payment and delivery pipeline to ensure it's working correctly; Go live and start processing transactions; Scale your business by adding more products, increasing payment volume, and configuring your Cloudflare Workers script to handle multiple payment notifications.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

You can receive crypto payments for your digital products by setting up a NOWPayments webhook and connecting it to your Cloudflare Workers script. This will allow you to process transactions in seconds and send products to customers instantly.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on Tron take under $0.10 per transaction in network fees, and are processed in seconds, whereas PayPal payments can take several days to arrive.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to naira using a peer-to-peer exchange like Binance or Patricia, and then use NOWPayments to process USDT payments for their digital products.
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for transactions, and offers fast and secure payment processing for digital products.
Can I use multiple cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments?
Yes, you can use multiple cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments, and choose the one that works best for your business needs.
